name: Screenshot
summary: This EA captures a screenshot of the current chart when the 's' key is pressed, saving it as a PNG file in the MQL5/Files directory. The screenshot filename includes a user-defined prefix and the current date. It also disables chart autoscroll and sets the chart to candlestick mode on initialization.
summary_zh: 这个EA在按下's'键时截取当前图表的屏幕截图，并将PNG文件保存到MQL5/Files目录中。截图文件名包含用户自定义的前缀和当前日期。初始化时会禁用图表自动滚动并设置图表为K线模式。
strategy_analysis: 这个EA不是一个交易策略，而是一个实用工具，用于在用户按下's'键时截取当前图表的屏幕截图。入场条件为键盘's'键被按下（ASCII码83），通过OnChartEvent事件处理函数检测CHARTEVENT_KEYDOWN事件。出场条件不适用，因为该EA不进行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理均不适用，该EA不涉及任何订单或持仓操作。EA在初始化时禁用了图表自动滚动、关闭右边缘偏移、并将图表模式设置为K线图，以确保截图的一致性。截图分辨率为固定的1920x1080像素，对齐方式为居中。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a utility tool that captures a screenshot of the current chart when the user presses the 's' key. The entry condition is a CHARTEVENT_KEYDOWN event where the key parameter matches the ASCII code 83 (the 's' key). Exit conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trades. Position sizing and money management are not applicable as the EA does not handle any orders or positions. On initialization, the EA disables chart autoscroll, turns off the right-edge shift, and sets the chart to candlestick mode to ensure consistent screenshot output. The screenshot resolution is fixed at 1920x1080 pixels with center alignment, and the output file is saved in the terminal's MQL5/Files directory with a date-stamped filename.
pros: 功能简单明确，按's'键即可快速截取图表截图，操作便捷
截图文件名自动包含日期信息，便于归档和管理
初始化时统一设置图表显示模式，确保截图的一致性
代码简洁，只有55行，易于理解和修改
pros_en: Simple and clear functionality — pressing 's' quickly captures a chart screenshot with convenient operation
Screenshot filenames automatically include date information for easy archiving and management
Initialization standardizes chart display settings to ensure consistent screenshot output
Clean and concise code at only 55 lines, easy to understand and modify
cons: 截图分辨率硬编码为1920x1080，无法通过参数调整，灵活性不足
仅支持's'键触发，无法自定义快捷键
缺少错误处理，当ChartScreenShot失败时没有给用户失败反馈
文件名中日期格式可能包含冒号导致部分系统兼容性问题
cons_en: Screenshot resolution is hardcoded to 1920x1080 with no parameter to adjust it, lacking flexibility
Only the 's' key triggers the screenshot with no way to customize the hotkey
Lacks error handling — no user feedback when ChartScreenShot fails
The date format in the filename may contain colons causing compatibility issues on some systems
improvements: 将截图宽度和高度改为可配置的输入参数，增加灵活性
添加对齐方式（ALIGN_LEFT/ALIGN_RIGHT/ALIGN_CENTER）作为可配置参数
增加ChartScreenShot失败时的错误提示，改善用户体验
improvements_en: Make screenshot width and height configurable input parameters for greater flexibility
Add alignment option (ALIGN_LEFT/ALIGN_RIGHT/ALIGN_CENTER) as a configurable parameter
Add error notification when ChartScreenShot fails to improve user experience

risk_points: 该EA不进行任何交易操作，无交易风险
截图文件保存在本地目录，无网络或安全风险
risk_points_en: This EA does not perform any trading operations, posing no trading risk
Screenshot files are saved locally, with no network or security risks
